caption.hook: Perplexity launched Teammates, AI agents that take on work tasks on their own.
body: Per The Verge and Engadget, Teammates run inside Perplexity Computer, work around the clock and can operate as a group in the same workspace. Each has its own thread in the sidebar, where users see what is finished, and one agent can bring in others to split a larger task.

Access is limited to the Max plan, at $200 a month, already live on the web and on iOS. The Verge compares the launch to OpenAI's Dots and a similar Anthropic agent. CEO Aravind Srinivas says he expects hundreds of agents per person over time, but that is a projection, not a feature available today.
